            } else {
                positionsX[countX++] = i;

        dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;
        for (int vCount = 0; vCount <= countV; vCount++) {
            for (int kCount = 0; kCount <= countK; kCount++) {
                for (int xCount = 0; xCount <= countX; xCount++) {
                    for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
                        long current = dp[vCount][kCount][xCount][t];
                        if (current == Long.MAX_VALUE) continue;

                            int moves = countSmaller(positionsV, vCount, vv) + countSmaller(positionsK, kCount, vv) + countSmaller(positionsX, xCount, vv);
                            dp[vCount + 1][kCount][xCount][1] = Math.min(dp[vCount + 1][kCount][xCount][1], current + moves);

                            dp[vCount][kCount][xCount + 1][0] = Math.min(dp[vCount][kCount][xCount + 1][0], current + moves);
